start.title: Did your period start on {{date}}?
start.lead: You logged bleeding those days. Tell us what it was to adjust your cycle.

close.title: Did your period end?
close.lead: You haven't logged bleeding for a few days. Your last day was {{date}}.
close.hint: Trailing spotting doesn't count: the closing date is the last day of real bleeding.

merge.title: Was it the same period?
merge.lead: Your last period ended on {{previousEndDate}} and there's bleeding again on {{newStartDate}} — only {{gapDays}} days of pause.
merge.hint: A short pause within the same period is common. If you merge them, they're saved as a single episode.

empty.title: Nothing to confirm
empty.lead: There's no pending proposal right now.

list.title: Your periods
list.lead: Tap one to correct dates or mark it as excluded.
list.empty: You haven't logged any periods yet.

detail.title: Edit period
detail.lead: Change the dates or mark this episode as excluded.
detail.excludeSubtitle: Doesn't count toward your cycle or your stats.
detail.excludeWarning: This period is no longer used for your prediction or your stats. It stays visible in your history.
detail.deleteConfirmBody: It's removed from your history and your predictions are recalculated.
detail.overlapError: Those dates overlap with another logged period.
detail.rangeError: The end can't be before the start.
